newsitem.title: GERMANY: Rolls-Royce chief sees no sale to BMW - paper.
newsitem.headline: Rolls-Royce chief sees no sale to BMW - paper.

text.p: U.K. luxury car maker Rolls-Royce will not be sold to German car maker BMW, the group's chief executive Chris Woodwark told a German newspaper.
"Rolls Royce is not for sale," Woodwark told German newspaper Sueddeutsche Zeitung in its Monday edition, brushing off persistent rumours the U.K. group would be bought by BMW.
Woodwark said Royce posted a 12 percent rise in car sales to 1,744 units last year but declined to give any profit figures.
In 1995 the group posted sales of 350 million pounds ($569.3 million) which translated into a 30 million profit. ($ = 0.614 British Pounds) --Frankfurt Newsroom, +49 69 756525
